# HH Workshop

A facilitated masters-cohort course around a shared, air-gapped local mage: the **babblefish recursion** — sci-fi narrative → poem → white paper → recurse — with a blind, hash-drawn gate checking that understanding survives translation. Understanding is the key; expressions are both key and food; a rotating steward trains the room's own mage; the cohort graduates owning its evaluation harness, three bound books, and verifiable provenance as the mage's first trainers.

translation-debt: **32** of 93 (claim, form) pairs · 113-node knowledge web

## The pages

- [[the-claim-register]] — the frozen census the gate probes
- [[the-knowledge-web]] — the workshop as a derived graph (the data rides in the page)
- [[the-steward-chain]] — provenance: who trained the mage on what, when
- [[the-workshop-law]] — the law, compiling (Lexon) · [[law-babblefish-gate]] · [[law-workshop-consent]] · [[law-fold]]
- [[the-roster]] — the cohort's personas and earned trust edges
- [[the-chronicles]] — the session records
- triptych pages — one per counted rendering

## The rite

One good name per mage; carry your own resolver; consent is the first stake; the seal says *this room reached the shared mind together*. A trust that certifies itself is the one you cannot trust — so the doors stay human and the witnesses stay outside.

story.text: the first circle of Hitchhiker FM — the oasis this workshop federates toward.
